title: A successful download shows the format-specific success notification, verbatim
refs: specs/inventory-value.md Story 10 S10-R13; §7 User Feedback Summary
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. The Inventory Value report is open with rows loaded (under the export cap).
custom_steps:
1. Download the PDF and read the notification.
2. Download the CSV and read the notification.
custom_expected:
1. The PDF download shows a success notification: "Inventory Value report exported (PDF)".
2. The CSV download shows a success notification: "Inventory Value report exported (CSV)".
